//: The names and versions the frame's packages publish under, and the DSH release they are built against. The CLI ships this file (an app made with init --desktop installs these names and versions), and verify-frame-publish packs exactly these packages: the closure of the frame's rows, nothing else. The owner's naming decision is the `scope` value and the short names; the owner confirmed these names on 2026-11-05, so a rename after the first publish is a new package on npm. A version must equal its package folder's package.json version (the CLI tests check it). A package whose source lives outside ide/ (shared with ACRYL, spec 051) names its folder with `path`, relative to this file's framework root; the key is that folder's name.

pnpm.//: An app in the frame installed with pnpm: these build scripts run, as they do under npm (packages/cli/src/pnpm-settings.ts). Found by installing a framed app with pnpm 12: dsh-subprocess-local builds its spawn helper, node-pty and koffi their native parts.

omit.//: What the frame inherits from DSH but does not install: DSH's web app composes the Office-to-PDF converter, whose LibreOffice engine is 153 MB per OS (measured 2026-11-18, about a third of a frame app's packages). Every app gets an npm override that swaps each engine package for `placeholder` (an empty package), and the converter's row is switched off; the document preview's Office part then waits for the converter and every other preview works. The Office preview plugin in the plugin registry brings the engine back on demand. packages/cli/src/frame-omit.ts reads this.

plugins.//: Plugins published from their own repositories under their own npm names, mounted by every app's frame and installed at a caret over this version. Not packed by verify-frame-publish (they are not under ide/). An upgrade adds one an app lacks.
